## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, intended change, and any compatibility effect.

## Evidence

List checks actually run, independently derived numerical results where relevant,
and any checks that remain unverified.

## Review

- [ ] The change stays within the documented scope.
- [ ] Public conventions and failure behavior are documented and tested.
- [ ] Worked examples and learner comparisons still agree with executed results.
- [ ] No private data, secrets, local paths, or unsupported claims are included.
- [ ] Public changes have an appropriate changelog entry.
